subject: Initial discovery roundtable — coordinating AE/SE + eng + procurement
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nebula-tech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + discovery — Nebula (AE + Eng + Procurement)

Hey Soojin — nice to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the notes from last week — the execs liked what they saw in the quick overview. We want to set up a 60-minute discovery "roundtable" where our champion, engineering lead, and procurement/legal can all attend so we can cover architecture, security, and contracting expectations in one go.

Attendees on our side: me (champion), Tim Zhao (Engineering Lead), Priya Menon (Procurement).

Possible windows (PST):
- Tue Jul 17, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Jul 18, 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00

Please include SE and AE from your side. Also, if you have a short prep checklist we can look at ahead of time, that would be helpful for procurement/security.

Thanks,
Alyssa

--
Alyssa Grant
Head of Product Partnerships, Nebula Tech
alyssa@nebula-tech.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nebula-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery — Nebula (AE + Eng + Procurement)

Thanks Alyssa — great summary and that roundtable approach makes sense. Marissa (AE) and Karthik (SE) will join. Quick notes:

- We can cover architecture, data flows, compliance posture (SOC 2, retention), and procurement milestones in 60 minutes if we stick to a tight agenda.
- Can you confirm whether Tim wants a live demo of inference latency/cost models or prefers an architecture discussion only? That determines whether we should reserve a GPU-backed demo environment.
- Attach: discovery checklist + a stub attendee CSV to confirm names/roles.

Availability from our side (PST):
- Tue Jul 17: 14:00–15:00 (Marissa available)
- Wed Jul 18: 09:00–10:00 (Karthik available) or 15:00–16:00 (both available)

If procurement needs a separate legal point of contact, happy to loop in our contracts lead after the discovery.

Proposed next step: if you can confirm which of the four windows works and whether you want a demo, I'll lock the slot and send a calendar invite with the agenda.

Cheers,

Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0987

Attachments: redwood-discovery-checklist.pdf, nebulatech-initial-attendees.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nebula-tech.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery — Nebula (AE + Eng + Procurement)

Hi all — happy to take the AE side. Quick clarifications from my side:

1) If Tim wants a demo, we can do a short 10–15 min live demo (latency + cost tradeoffs) followed by architecture + procurement questions. Need a 30-min buffer beforehand to warm up our demo instance.
2) Procurement questions we can answer at a high level: licensing model, committed capacity options (Dedicated), and data handling. For legal redlines we bring in contracts after the discovery unless procurement insists on seeing standard T&Cs first.

My availability: Tue Jul 17 14:00–15:00 works best. If that aligns with you, we can confirm and get calendar invites out.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Timothy Zhao <tim.zhao@nebula-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nebula-tech.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery — Nebula (AE + Eng + Procurement)

Thanks — quick note from engineering side. We prefer Wed Jul 18 15:00–16:00 PST because our infra lead is only available then; Tue afternoon conflicts with a release window. Also, we do not need a live demo — architecture + expected token cost model will be enough for now.

Attendees (final):
- Alyssa Grant (Champion)
- Timothy Zhao (Eng Lead)
- Priya Menon (Procurement)
- Aaron Liu (Infra Engineer)

If you can shift to Wed 15:00–16:00 PST, that would be ideal. Otherwise we may have to split procurement into a follow-up.

On security: we already have a short SOC 2 questionnaire; if you can send a pointer to any additional items we should prepare, that'd help Priya.

Thanks,
Tim
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Zhao <tim.zhao@nebula-tech.com>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa@nebula-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery — Nebula (AE + Eng + Procurement)

Great — thanks for the heads-up, Tim. Wed Jul 18 15:00–16:00 PST is confirmed on our side. I've attached a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and included a tight agenda below so we can make the most of the hour: 

Agenda (60m):
- 00:00–05:00 — Intros + goals (Alyssa)
- 05:00–20:00 — Architecture overview (Karthik)
- 20:00–35:00 — Cost/latency tradeoffs & deployment options (Marissa + Soojin)
- 35:00–50:00 — Procurement/compliance Q&A (Priya)
- 50:00–60:00 — Next steps & action items

Prep items for Nebula (small asks):
- Bring any network diagrams or data-flow constraints (Aaron/Tim)
- Procurement: any minimum SLAs or resale requirements to call out in the discovery
- Security: if there's anything beyond SOC 2 we should see in advance, share that doc (we've linked our brief checklist).

Links & attachments:
- Discovery prep doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-discovery-prep
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/112233/company/nebula-tech
- Attachments: redwood-discovery-checklist.pdf, nebulatech-initial-attendees.csv, calendar-invite.ics

I'll send the meeting invite now. If procurement would like a short pre-read (1 pager) on pricing models, Marissa will attach it to the invite.

See you Wednesday — thanks all.

Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
